events.verdict: Jackson (MEM) moves into Banchero's (ORL) path and delivers body contact that affects Banchero's shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) brings his arm around Carter Jr.'s (ORL) upper body and initiates contact to Carter Jr.'s head, affecting his ability to defend.
Banchero (ORL) initiates contact with Aldama's (MEM) lower body that affects his jump shot.

Banchero's (ORL) left forearm makes contact with Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) head as his right hand deflects the ball away from Jackson Jr.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Aldama (MEM) and Black (ORL) come together at the same spot as Aldama secures possession, and the contact is marginal.
Bane (ORL) legally contests Spencer's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Coward (MEM) dislodges Wagner (ORL) from his rebounding position.
Landale (MEM) and Carter Jr. (ORL) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: There is no clear and conclusive camera angle that confirms Carter Jr. (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Banchero (ORL) legally contests Spencer's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Wagner (ORL) goes to, not through, Aldama's (MEM) space as he releases away from the contact.
Wagner (ORL) legally contests Coward's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) legally contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Coward (MEM) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Magic.
Williams Jr. (MEM) commits a take foul on Wagner (ORL).
Wagner (ORL) brushes Coward's (MEM) side during his drive and the contact is marginal.
Banchero (ORL) legally contests Coward's (MEM) shot attempt.
Aldama (MEM) commits a take foul on Bane (ORL).
Black (ORL) legally contests Coward's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
